name: Greece
country_code_note: Folder and template files use GR (the code in the supplied templates). CTIS titles use EL, the code CTIS and the EU use for Greece (DECISIONS.md D1). Language code: el.

authorities.competent_authority: EOF (National Organization for Medicines, Εθνικός Οργανισμός Φαρμάκων): Greek national competent authority; issues the national decision
authorities.ethics: National Ethics Committee for Clinical Studies (Εθνική Επιτροπή Δεοντολογίας, ΕΕΔ): assesses the ethical aspects of Part II through CTIS
authorities.fee: Not stated in the Greece guides (DECISIONS.md, Missing). Proof of fee, where needed, goes in the CTIS Forms section, not Part II (naming guide).
authorities.national_law: Joint Ministerial Decision G5a/59676, Government Gazette B 4131/22.12.2016 (Greek implementing decision); Joint Ministerial Decision D3(a)18899, Government Gazette B 2138/03.05.2022; Government Gazette B 230/22.01.2026 (financial annexes)
authorities.trial_sites: A clinical trial site in Greece must be a public hospital or private clinic with suitable infrastructure.

language_rules.rule: Participant information, informed consent forms, patient cards and other material intended for participants or caregivers must be in Greek. Many administrative Part II documents may be submitted in English, subject to an official Greek translation if EOF requests one. Greece recommends English for K1, M1, M2, N1, P1, R1 and S1; the insurance certificate is accepted in Greek or English.
language_rules.non_greek_speakers: If a Greek site expects to enrol someone who does not understand Greek, provide information in a language the person understands and submit a valid or certified translation in CTIS; a later translation is based on the approved Greek version and submitted through the appropriate route (GR-L1-TRANSLATION).
language_rules.endpoint_documents: Endpoint-related questionnaires and patient-reported outcome instruments go with the protocol in Part I under EU rules and are not duplicated as Part II participant material (outside_part_ii).
language_rules.form_answers: Part II forms (shared EU templates in content/eu/templates/part-ii) are answered in English, as the Greece guide recommends. The supplied CTIS_GR forms and variable sheet were prepared for Greek answers (DECISIONS.md D2).
language_rules.by_language_note: en: English is recommended or accepted; el: Greek required (participant documents) or accepted (O1, and documents for which the guides give no language). GR-L1-TRANSLATION is in the language the participant understands.
language_rules.drafting_notes_language: drafting_notes_en for administrative documents, drafting_notes_el for participant documents.

study_facts_note: Country-specific keys for Greece: population.non_greek_speakers (enrolment of people who do not understand Greek), trial.phase_1 (Phase I documents under M and N), compensation.offered (P1 is conditional in Greece), finance.details_provided_for_ethics_review (Government Gazette B 230/2026 annexes), consent.audio_video_recording (the Greek alternative recording route with a witness). consent.electronic: the Greek guidance describes in-person paper consent; any other approach only where expressly accepted for the trial.

documents.ctis_section: Part II Trial sites (CTIS structured data)
documents.ctis_title: none (CTIS Part II Trial Sites structured data; no document upload)
documents.content: Complete the CTIS Part II Trial Sites structured data for every Greek site. A clinical trial site in Greece must be a public hospital or private clinic with suitable infrastructure. Site, department and principal-investigator details must be identical in CTIS and every document.
documents.drafting_notes_en: CTIS Part II Trial Sites structured data; no document. Mandatory. One entry per Greek site; each site must be a public hospital or a private clinic with suitable infrastructure. No separate signature. Check that site, department and principal investigator match M1, M2, N1 and every participant document.

template.basis: EudraLex Volume 10 Recruitment and Informed Consent Procedure template, version 2.0 (applies to new Part II submissions from 1 September 2026); Greece recommends completion in English

documents.signature_note: The Greece guides set no signature for K1; the EU template has no signature block.
documents.content: How potential participants are identified, approached, informed and consented, with the Greek in-person paper-consent process and every population pathway in the plan (incapacitated adults under court-appointed support, minors, impartial witness, emergency). The emergency section must describe identification, eligibility confirmation, the prior-objection check, the representative search, enrolment authorisation and documentation.

national_fields.v105: Greece: participant-facing recruitment material is in Greek and used only in its approved version; advertisements are factual, do not promise benefit, do not imply that the product is safe or approved and do not emphasise payment; no incentives to enrol or remain (National Ethics Committee, 22 July 2026). Recruitment does not include the groups the Greek implementing decision (JMD G5a/59676, Government Gazette B 4131/2016) excludes from clinical trials: people serving compulsory military service, people serving a custodial sentence, people barred by court decision and people living in institutions. For healthy volunteers: screening privacy, repeat-enrolment controls and any registry checks.
national_fields.v108: Greece: consent is obtained in a prior interview by a qualified investigator or authorised study-team member, in person and on paper (National Ethics Committee ICF guidance, 11 October 2019): the participant and the investigator or authorised team member sign and enter the full date in the same consent encounter; the participant receives a signed copy and the site keeps the original. Information and consent form one continuously paginated Greek document. A participant who does not understand Greek receives information in a language they understand and a valid or certified translation submitted in CTIS, based on the approved Greek form. Trial-specific products, examinations and procedures are not charged to the participant or their public or private insurer. A different consent approach (for example electronic) only where expressly accepted for the trial.
national_fields.v110: Greece: the pathway applies only to adults under court-ordered full deprivation, partial deprivation or assistance (mental or intellectual disorder, prodigality, drug dependence or alcoholism); the scope of the court order is confirmed, and a diagnosis, temporary confusion, family preference or hospitalisation does not establish it. The legally designated representative is the court-appointed judicial supporter exercising the relevant care function; evidence of appointment and authority stays in the site file and is provided to the National Ethics Committee on request. The participant receives adapted Greek information and gives written agreement when and to the extent able; a capable refusal or wish to withdraw is binding. The representative's consent expresses the participant's presumed will and can be withdrawn at any time. Witnesses never replace the representative. When the participant regains capacity, own consent on the adult form; capacity changes and their timing are defined in the protocol. No incentives beyond expenses and loss of earnings. Greek exclusions apply (compulsory military service, custodial sentence, barred by court decision, living in institutions).
national_fields.v114: Greece: both parents who exercise parental responsibility consent jointly in writing with full dates, or the court-appointed guardian. One parent alone only when the other's parental responsibility has ended (death, declaration of absence, legal removal), or the other is demonstrably unable to exercise it for factual reasons (formal declaration attached to the consent form) or lacks the relevant legal capacity; day-to-day custody alone is not enough; disagreement goes to the court. From age 10 the minor gives separate written, signed and dated assent after age-appropriate information from the principal investigator, an investigator or an authorised team member trained or experienced with children; below 10 the child is informed according to understanding and a capable child's refusal is respected. A capable minor's refusal or withdrawal is binding. Own adult consent when the participant turns 18. The 10th and 18th birthday transitions are operationally defined.
national_fields.v117: Greece (JMD G5a/59676, Article 9): a deaf participant or one unable to speak receives the information in writing and asks questions in writing, with at least one independent witness present throughout who co-signs; a participant unable to read or write: the forms are signed by the authorised team member and two independent witnesses. Each witness has legal capacity and is not connected with the trial in any way; independence is confirmed and documented. Alternatively, consent may be recorded by an approved audio or video method with at least one independent witness present, who signs; method, storage, access, privacy and retention are described. An interpreter is not automatically a witness. A witness is never a legal representative.
national_fields.v121: Greece (JMD G5a/59676, Article 12): all Article 35 conditions; operational inconvenience, staffing or inability to reach a preferred relative never substitute for the test. For Article 35 only, the legally designated representative may also be the spouse, civil partner, an adult descendant, an ascendant or a sibling, whoever's informed consent can be obtained most quickly; this definition is not reused for ordinary consent. As soon as possible after the intervention, information and consent for continued participation from the participant or the representative; the participant's own decision controls once capable. Refusal stops further trial-specific interventions; data and samples already obtained are handled as explained. Emergency minors move to the child and parental pathway as soon as possible; participants under court-appointed support use the judicial supporter when available.

documents.drafting_notes_en: CTIS Part II section K (Recruitment arrangements). Mandatory. Answer in English (Greece recommends English; see language_rules). No signature. Use the EU template version 2.0. Complete the section of every population pathway in the plan and give the template's not-applicable answer for each 'no'. Put the Greek rules in the Member State fields (national_fields): in-person paper consent with full dates and a signed copy, Greek documents and certified translations, two-parent consent and assent from 10, court-appointed judicial supporter, one- or two-witness and audio/video routes, the Article 35 emergency representative list, the excluded groups. The recruitment routes and first act of recruitment must match every K2 item and the protocol.

documents.trigger_text: Recruitment advertisements or other participant-facing recruitment material (including prescreening material shown to healthy volunteers).
documents.signature_note: Blank recruitment materials are not signed at submission unless their own format requires approval or attestation.
documents.content: Final Greek material, uploaded in the CTIS Recruitment Arrangements section. Factual; no promise of benefit, no implication that the product is safe or approved, no emphasis on payment that could distort the decision.
documents.drafting_notes_el: CTIS Μέρος II, ενότητα K (Recruitment Arrangements). Υπό όρους: μόνο όταν χρησιμοποιείται υλικό στρατολόγησης. Στα ελληνικά, τελική μορφή. Χωρίς υπογραφή κατά την υποβολή, εκτός αν η μορφή του υλικού απαιτεί έγκριση ή βεβαίωση. Περιεχόμενο πραγματικό και μη διαφημιστικό: καμία υπόσχεση οφέλους, καμία ένδειξη ότι το προϊόν είναι ασφαλές ή εγκεκριμένο, χωρίς έμφαση στην αμοιβή. Σε κάθε σελίδα τύπος εγγράφου, κωδικός ή ακρωνύμιο πρωτοκόλλου, έκδοση και ημερομηνία. Οι οδοί στρατολόγησης πρέπει να συμφωνούν με το K1.

documents.name_en: Participant information and informed consent form, one set per population
documents.template_note: Participant templates are bound per population through population_sets.
documents.content: Every applicable blank Greek Patient Information Sheet and Informed Consent Form, uploaded in Subject Information and Informed Consent Form: adults, minors, parents or guardians, legal representatives, pregnancy follow-up, optional substudies or future use, and other populations the protocol requires. Not signed at submission, but with every future signature and full-date field that could apply (participant, both parents, legally designated representative, investigator or authorised team member, witnesses where national rules require them). See population_sets.
documents.drafting_notes_el: CTIS Μέρος II, ενότητα L (Subject Information and Informed Consent Form). Υποχρεωτικό, ένα σύνολο εγγράφων ανά πληθυσμό. Στα ελληνικά. Η ΕΕΔ θεωρεί το κείμενο πληροφόρησης και τη σελίδα συναίνεσης ενιαίο Έντυπο Συναίνεσης μετά από Ενημέρωση με συνεχή αρίθμηση σελίδων και συνολικό αριθμό σελίδων· σε κάθε σελίδα τύπος εγγράφου, κωδικός ή ακρωνύμιο πρωτοκόλλου, έκδοση και ημερομηνία. Περιεχόμενο κατά τις οδηγίες της ΕΕΔ (11 Οκτωβρίου 2019): τίτλος, χορηγός, αριθμός δοκιμής ΕΕ, ερευνητής, ελληνικό κέντρο και στοιχεία επικοινωνίας· πάθηση και υπό έρευνα φάρμακο· σκοπός· θεραπείες, τυχαιοποίηση, εικονικό φάρμακο ή συγκριτικό, πιθανότητα κατανομής, θεραπεία διάσωσης· εναλλακτικές· επισκέψεις, διαδικασίες, δείγματα, διάρκεια· κίνδυνοι, περιορισμοί· οφέλη και ενδεχόμενη απουσία προσωπικού οφέλους· αντισύλληψη, κύηση, θηλασμός· κόστος, αποζημίωση εξόδων, ασφάλιση και αποζημίωση βλάβης· εθελοντική συμμετοχή και ανάκληση· προαιρετικές δραστηριότητες· προστασία δεδομένων (υπεύθυνος επεξεργασίας, Υπεύθυνος Προστασίας Δεδομένων, σκοποί και νομικές βάσεις, αποδέκτες, διαβιβάσεις σε τρίτες χώρες, διατήρηση, δικαιώματα, καταγγελία στην Αρχή Προστασίας Δεδομένων Προσωπικού Χαρακτήρα) σε μία ενιαία ενότητα· άμεση πρόσβαση στα αρχεία από εξουσιοδοτημένους εκπροσώπους του χορηγού, τον ΕΟΦ, την ΕΕΔ και άλλους αρμόδιους επιθεωρητές· δημόσια καταχώριση και περίληψη αποτελεσμάτων· νέες πληροφορίες· επαφές. Ρητή διαβεβαίωση ότι ο συμμετέχων και ο δημόσιος ή ιδιωτικός ασφαλιστικός φορέας του δεν επιβαρύνονται με κόστος για υπό έρευνα ή βοηθητικά προϊόντα, εξετάσεις, διαδικασίες ή θεραπεία βλάβης που σχετίζεται με τη δοκιμή. Η ΕΕΔ αναφέρεται για ερωτήματα δεοντολογίας, όχι ως αρχή καταγγελιών. Το έντυπο υποβάλλεται κενό και ανυπόγραφο, με όλα τα πεδία υπογραφής και πλήρους ημερομηνίας που ενδέχεται να εφαρμοστούν· πεδία εκπροσώπου και μαρτύρων μόνο όπου το πρωτόκολλο μπορεί να χρησιμοποιήσει τις αντίστοιχες διαδρομές. Διαδικασία συναίνεσης με φυσική παρουσία, σε χαρτί, με υπογεγραμμένο αντίγραφο για τον συμμετέχοντα. Σε τροποποίηση: καθαρή και με εμφανείς αλλαγές (track changes) ελληνική έκδοση.

documents.name_en: Other participant or caregiver information given before or at consent
documents.trigger_text: Other patient or caregiver leaflets, education material, patient cards, payment explanations or study instructions provided before or during consent.
documents.drafting_notes_el: CTIS Μέρος II, ενότητα L. Υπό όρους: κάθε άλλο φυλλάδιο ή ενημερωτικό υλικό για ασθενή ή φροντιστή που δίνεται πριν ή κατά τη συναίνεση (εκπαιδευτικό υλικό, κάρτα ασθενούς, οδηγίες μελέτης, εξήγηση πληρωμών). Στα ελληνικά. Σε κάθε σελίδα τύπος εγγράφου, κωδικός ή ακρωνύμιο πρωτοκόλλου, έκδοση και ημερομηνία· συνεχής αρίθμηση με συνολικό αριθμό σελίδων. Ερωτηματολόγια καταληκτικών σημείων και εργαλεία PRO δεν ανήκουν εδώ: υποβάλλονται με το πρωτόκολλο στο Μέρος I.

documents.name_en: Valid or certified translation of the participant documents
documents.trigger_text: A Greek site expects to enrol a participant (or representative) who does not understand Greek.
documents.content: Valid or certified translation of each approved Greek participant document into the language the person understands, submitted in CTIS. A later translation is based on the approved Greek version and submitted through the applicable CTIS application route.
documents.kind_note: Checked against the approved Greek version; DECISIONS.md D11 asks whether the assistant should prepare a draft for the translator.
documents.drafting_notes_el: CTIS Μέρος II, ενότητα L. Υπό όρους: όταν αναμένεται ένταξη προσώπου που δεν κατανοεί τα ελληνικά. Έγκυρη ή επικυρωμένη μετάφραση κάθε εγκεκριμένου ελληνικού εντύπου στη γλώσσα που κατανοεί το πρόσωπο, βασισμένη στην εγκεκριμένη ελληνική έκδοση· μεταγενέστερη μετάφραση υποβάλλεται μέσω της κατάλληλης διαδικασίας CTIS. Ο τίτλος CTIS φέρει τον κωδικό ISO της γλώσσας της μετάφρασης.

template.basis: EU Investigator Curriculum Vitae template, or a similar document; Greece recommends it, completed in English

documents.signature_rule: The Greek Part II Q&A directs signature questions to the EU CTR Q&A: no signature added by habit; sign only where the current template instructions or an explicit National Ethics Committee request require it.
documents.content: Short CV of the principal investigator of each Greek site stating relevant qualifications, experience and current Good Clinical Practice training. Personal details come from the investigator.
documents.drafting_notes_en: CTIS Part II section M. Mandatory, one per principal investigator and Greek site. EU CV template (or similar) recommended, in English. Must state relevant qualifications, experience and current GCP training. The assistant fills only the trial fields (EU trial number); everything else is completed by the investigator. No signature unless the template instructions or the National Ethics Committee explicitly ask for one.

template.basis: EU declaration-of-interest template, or a similar document; normally in English

documents.signature_rule: No signature added by habit; only where the current template instructions or an explicit National Ethics Committee request require it (Greek Part II Q&A, referring to the EU CTR Q&A).
documents.drafting_notes_en: CTIS Part II section M. Mandatory, one per principal investigator and Greek site. EU template (or similar), normally English. The assistant fills only the trial title and EU trial number; the interests are declared by the investigator. Signature only if the template instructions or the National Ethics Committee explicitly require it.

documents.ctis_title: M2_Phase I site and team declaration_<investigator>_<site>
documents.name_en: Principal investigator declaration that the site and research team meet Article 7 of Government Gazette B 4131/2016 (Phase I)
documents.trigger_text: Phase I trial (Greek Part II Q&A, Phase I investigator and facility requirements).
documents.signature_rule: Signed by the principal investigator before upload.
documents.content: Signed declaration by the principal investigator that the site and research team meet Article 7 of JMD G5a/59676 (Government Gazette B 4131/22.12.2016). Uploaded under suitability of the investigator; the same declaration is also referred to under suitability of the facilities (GR-N-PHASE1; DECISIONS.md D7).
documents.drafting_notes_en: CTIS Part II section M. Conditional: Phase I trials only. Signed principal-investigator declaration that the site and research team meet Article 7 of Government Gazette B 4131/2016. No template supplied; the guides give no wording and no language rule beyond 'most administrative documents can be in English'. The assistant does not draft or sign it; it checks that one signed declaration exists per Greek site and that it matches GR-N-PHASE1. The naming guide gives no title for it (DECISIONS.md D7).

documents.name_en: Advanced Life Support certificates of the principal investigator and relevant research-team members (Phase I)
documents.content: Current Advanced Life Support certificates for the principal investigator and the relevant research-team members.
documents.drafting_notes_en: CTIS Part II section M. Conditional: Phase I trials only. Current ALS certificates for the principal investigator and relevant team members; issued by the training provider. Proposed as one combined upload per site so that team members' names stay out of the CTIS title (naming guide: personal names only for the principal investigator; DECISIONS.md D8).

template.basis: EU site-suitability template; Greece recommends it, completed in English

documents.signature_rule: Signed by the principal investigator at submission.

national_fields.n1_issued_by: Greece requires the principal investigator's signature at submission: leave the signature block empty in the draft; the principal investigator signs the final form before upload.

documents.content: One form per Greek site in Suitability of the Facilities: facilities, equipment, procedures and human resources for this protocol. For Phase I, the principal investigator's Article 7 declaration and evidence of appropriate equipment and emergency capability are added (GR-N-PHASE1).
documents.filled_by: assistant; site fields left empty for the site; signed by the principal investigator
documents.drafting_notes_en: CTIS Part II section N (Suitability of the facilities). Mandatory, one per Greek site. EU template recommended, in English. Signed by the principal investigator at submission (national_fields n1_issued_by): leave the block empty in the draft. Site details (name, department, principal investigator, participant numbers) stay empty for the site. The site must be a public hospital or private clinic with suitable infrastructure. Describe protocol-specific facilities, equipment, procedures and staff; for Phase I trials include the emergency capability that GR-N-PHASE1 evidences.

documents.ctis_title: N<next number>_Phase I declaration and equipment evidence_<site>
documents.name_en: Phase I facility evidence: principal investigator Article 7 declaration and evidence of appropriate equipment and emergency capability
documents.signature_rule: The declaration is signed by the principal investigator; equipment evidence is supplied by the site.
documents.content: The principal investigator's declaration that the site and team meet Article 7 of Government Gazette B 4131/2016, with the required evidence of appropriate equipment and emergency capability.
documents.note: The naming guide gives no fixed code; use the next free N number under suitability of facilities.
documents.drafting_notes_en: CTIS Part II section N. Conditional: Phase I trials only. Principal-investigator Article 7 declaration (same signed version as GR-M-PHASE1-DECL) plus evidence of appropriate site equipment and emergency capability. Supplied by the investigator and site; the assistant checks consistency with N1.

documents.name_en: Proof of insurance cover or indemnification
documents.signature_rule: Executed by the insurer; a blank certificate is not enough where the proof of cover must be executed by the insurer.
documents.content: Insurance certificate identifying the trial and the coverage, containing the required pregnancy clause, and compliant with the Greek implementing decision (JMD G5a/59676) and the CTR. Accepted in Greek or English.
documents.drafting_notes_en: CTIS Part II section O (Proof of insurance cover or indemnification). Mandatory. Greek or English. Issued and executed by the insurer; the assistant does not draft it. Check that it identifies the trial and the coverage, contains the pregnancy clause, and that every participant and pregnancy form describes injury compensation consistently with it and promises nothing beyond the policy. The guides give no minimum amounts and no separate policy-terms document (DECISIONS.md, Missing).

documents.trigger_text: Participants receive reimbursement of expenses, directly related lost income or compensation for time or burden.

template.basis: EU Compensation for Trial Participants template; Greece recommends it, in English

documents.signature_note: The Greece guides set no signature for P1; the EU form has no signature block.
documents.content: Each benefit's type, amount or value, payment method and rationale. Accepted: actual participation expenses (for example travel, lodging, childcare), directly related lost income and reasonable compensation for time or burden; no incentives to enrol or remain. Specific limits for minors, incapacitated participants and pregnant or breastfeeding participants. Trial-specific medicines, procedures and examinations are not charged to participants or their public or private insurer.

national_fields.f02: Greece: for each benefit give its type, amount or value, payment method and rationale (National Ethics Committee clarification on financial benefits, 22 July 2026); amounts must match every Greek participant document.
national_fields.f04: Greece: monetary payment only as actual expense reimbursement, directly related lost income or reasonable compensation for time or burden, with justification; no incentive to enrol or remain. Minors and incapacitated adults: no incentives beyond expenses and loss of earnings directly related to participation; apply the specific limits for pregnant or breastfeeding participants.
national_fields.f06: Greece: state what happens after early withdrawal or investigator-directed discontinuation (prorating) and, where relevant, tax handling, as the participant documents explain it.

documents.drafting_notes_en: CTIS Part II section P. Conditional in Greece: only when participants receive reimbursement or compensation (DECISIONS.md D9 for trials with no payment). EU compensation template in English. Document each benefit's type, amount or value, payment method and rationale (national_fields). The National Ethics Committee accepts actual expenses, directly related lost income and reasonable compensation for time or burden and rejects incentives to enrol or remain (clarification of 22 July 2026). Specific limits for minors, incapacitated and pregnant or breastfeeding participants. Amounts and conditions identical in every Greek participant document. No signature.

documents.name_en: Financial details for ethics review (annexes of Government Gazette B 230/22.01.2026)
documents.trigger_text: Financial details are provided for ethics review: the applicable annexes of Government Gazette B 230/22.01.2026, including the per-participant fee analysis, the project-team list and the project budget.
documents.template_required: Annexes of Government Gazette B 230/22.01.2026 (per-participant fee analysis, project-team list, project budget); not in CTIS_GR (DECISIONS.md, Missing).
documents.signature_rule: The sponsor and investigator do not need to sign the annexes for CTIS submission. The fully signed sponsor–principal investigator financial agreement is no longer required in CTIS.
documents.drafting_notes_en: CTIS Part II section P. Conditional: where financial details are provided for ethics review, use the applicable annexes of Government Gazette B 230/22.01.2026 (per-participant fee analysis, project-team list, project budget); unsigned. Do not upload the signed sponsor–PI financial agreement (no longer required). Supplied by the sponsor; the assistant checks consistency with P1 and the participant documents. The language is not stated in the guides; the annexes are national forms (DECISIONS.md D10).

documents.ctis_title: R1_Compliance collection and use personal data_EL

template.basis: EudraLex GDPR compliance statement template; Greece recommends it, in English; no Greece-specific standalone document (MedEthicsEU Member State overview v4.0, 26 June 2026)

documents.signature_note: The Greece guides set no signature rule; the form's own name, role and date fields are completed for the sponsor (DECISIONS.md D13).
documents.content: Statement on compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 and on any transfer of personal data to third countries. No additional Greece-specific standalone Part II document. Participant-facing privacy information stays in the Greek consent material, consistent with this statement.

national_fields.r1_the_sponsor_declares: Not required in Greece: the 2026 Member State overview identifies no Greece-specific national statement; give the template's not-applicable answer. Make sure the statement covers any transfer of personal data to third countries.

documents.drafting_notes_en: CTIS Part II section R (data-protection compliance; the Greece guide calls it the CTIS Form statement on GDPR compliance). Mandatory. EudraLex template in English. No Greek national statement and no separate national document. Cover any transfer of personal data to third countries. The Greek participant documents carry the participant-facing privacy section (controller, DPO, purposes, legal bases, recipients, transfers, retention, rights, complaint to the Hellenic Data Protection Authority) and must match this statement.

documents.ctis_title: S1_Compliance collection use storage biological samples_EL
documents.name_en: Compliance with use of biological samples
documents.trigger_text: The trial collects, stores or proposes future use of human biological samples.

template.basis: EudraLex Compliance with Member State Applicable Rules for Biological Samples template, in English

documents.signature_note: The Greece guides set no signature for S1.

national_fields.f03: Greece: further use of samples is related to a similar scientific purpose and subject to competent-authority approval; optional future use has its own separate Greek consent (refusal does not affect the main trial); state whether samples may leave Greece or the EEA, be used by commercial partners, for genetic analysis, cell lines or research leading to intellectual property, and what happens to them on withdrawal.

documents.drafting_notes_en: CTIS Part II section S (Compliance with use of biological samples). Conditional: when human biological samples are collected, stored or proposed for future use. EU template in English; the participant-facing consent stays Greek. Must match the protocol, the sample plan, the Greek ICF and any separate optional-use form (secondary_use population set). Section 5 (f03): the Greek further-use rule (similar scientific purpose, competent-authority approval).

fields.v105: Greece: participant-facing recruitment material is in Greek and used only in its approved version; advertisements are factual, do not promise benefit, do not imply that the product is safe or approved and do not emphasise payment; no incentives to enrol or remain (National Ethics Committee, 22 July 2026). Recruitment does not include the groups the Greek implementing decision (JMD G5a/59676, Government Gazette B 4131/2016) excludes from clinical trials: people serving compulsory military service, people serving a custodial sentence, people barred by court decision and people living in institutions. For healthy volunteers: screening privacy, repeat-enrolment controls and any registry checks.
fields.v108: Greece: consent is obtained in a prior interview by a qualified investigator or authorised study-team member, in person and on paper (National Ethics Committee ICF guidance, 11 October 2019): the participant and the investigator or authorised team member sign and enter the full date in the same consent encounter; the participant receives a signed copy and the site keeps the original. Information and consent form one continuously paginated Greek document. A participant who does not understand Greek receives information in a language they understand and a valid or certified translation submitted in CTIS, based on the approved Greek form. Trial-specific products, examinations and procedures are not charged to the participant or their public or private insurer. A different consent approach (for example electronic) only where expressly accepted for the trial.
fields.v110: Greece: the pathway applies only to adults under court-ordered full deprivation, partial deprivation or assistance (mental or intellectual disorder, prodigality, drug dependence or alcoholism); the scope of the court order is confirmed, and a diagnosis, temporary confusion, family preference or hospitalisation does not establish it. The legally designated representative is the court-appointed judicial supporter exercising the relevant care function; evidence of appointment and authority stays in the site file and is provided to the National Ethics Committee on request. The participant receives adapted Greek information and gives written agreement when and to the extent able; a capable refusal or wish to withdraw is binding. The representative's consent expresses the participant's presumed will and can be withdrawn at any time. Witnesses never replace the representative. When the participant regains capacity, own consent on the adult form; capacity changes and their timing are defined in the protocol. No incentives beyond expenses and loss of earnings. Greek exclusions apply (compulsory military service, custodial sentence, barred by court decision, living in institutions).
fields.v114: Greece: both parents who exercise parental responsibility consent jointly in writing with full dates, or the court-appointed guardian. One parent alone only when the other's parental responsibility has ended (death, declaration of absence, legal removal), or the other is demonstrably unable to exercise it for factual reasons (formal declaration attached to the consent form) or lacks the relevant legal capacity; day-to-day custody alone is not enough; disagreement goes to the court. From age 10 the minor gives separate written, signed and dated assent after age-appropriate information from the principal investigator, an investigator or an authorised team member trained or experienced with children; below 10 the child is informed according to understanding and a capable child's refusal is respected. A capable minor's refusal or withdrawal is binding. Own adult consent when the participant turns 18. The 10th and 18th birthday transitions are operationally defined.
fields.v117: Greece (JMD G5a/59676, Article 9): a deaf participant or one unable to speak receives the information in writing and asks questions in writing, with at least one independent witness present throughout who co-signs; a participant unable to read or write: the forms are signed by the authorised team member and two independent witnesses. Each witness has legal capacity and is not connected with the trial in any way; independence is confirmed and documented. Alternatively, consent may be recorded by an approved audio or video method with at least one independent witness present, who signs; method, storage, access, privacy and retention are described. An interpreter is not automatically a witness. A witness is never a legal representative.
fields.v121: Greece (JMD G5a/59676, Article 12): all Article 35 conditions; operational inconvenience, staffing or inability to reach a preferred relative never substitute for the test. For Article 35 only, the legally designated representative may also be the spouse, civil partner, an adult descendant, an ascendant or a sibling, whoever's informed consent can be obtained most quickly; this definition is not reused for ordinary consent. As soon as possible after the intervention, information and consent for continued participation from the participant or the representative; the participant's own decision controls once capable. Refusal stops further trial-specific interventions; data and samples already obtained are handled as explained. Emergency minors move to the child and parental pathway as soon as possible; participants under court-appointed support use the judicial supporter when available.

fields.n1_issued_by: Greece requires the principal investigator's signature at submission: leave the signature block empty in the draft; the principal investigator signs the final form before upload.

fields.f02: Greece: for each benefit give its type, amount or value, payment method and rationale (National Ethics Committee clarification on financial benefits, 22 July 2026); amounts must match every Greek participant document.
fields.f04: Greece: monetary payment only as actual expense reimbursement, directly related lost income or reasonable compensation for time or burden, with justification; no incentive to enrol or remain. Minors and incapacitated adults: no incentives beyond expenses and loss of earnings directly related to participation; apply the specific limits for pregnant or breastfeeding participants.
fields.f06: Greece: state what happens after early withdrawal or investigator-directed discontinuation (prorating) and, where relevant, tax handling, as the participant documents explain it.

fields.r1_the_sponsor_declares: Not required in Greece: the 2026 Member State overview identifies no Greece-specific national statement; give the template's not-applicable answer. Make sure the statement covers any transfer of personal data to third countries.

fields.f03: Greece: further use of samples is related to a similar scientific purpose and subject to competent-authority approval; optional future use has its own separate Greek consent (refusal does not affect the main trial); state whether samples may leave Greece or the EEA, be used by commercial partners, for genetic analysis, cell lines or research leading to intellectual property, and what happens to them on withdrawal.

national_fields_note: Index of the national additions to shared forms; the same text is on each document (documents[].national_fields). Field ids are those of the shared <form>.fields.json. Written in English, the form answer language; the assistant writes the answers in the package answer language.

outside_part_ii.what: Endpoint-related questionnaires and patient-reported outcome instruments
outside_part_ii.where: Part I with the protocol (naming guide: D4_Patient-facing document_<type>_ENG); not duplicated as ordinary Part II participant material
outside_part_ii.note: Other educational or information material given before or during consent stays in Part II (GR-L2). The guides do not say whether Greek versions of Part I endpoint instruments are required for use at Greek sites (DECISIONS.md, Missing).

outside_part_ii.where: Site conduct records; not automatically a CTIS submission document
outside_part_ii.note: Records the emergency condition, therapeutic window, why consent was impossible, attempts to identify a representative, absence of known prior objection, who authorised enrolment and the time of intervention. No template supplied (DECISIONS.md D14).

outside_part_ii.where: CTIS Forms section (naming guide), if applicable

population_sets.note: Ordinary adult pathway. No representative, witness or emergency fields in this form (use the specific templates). Optional procedures inside the main trial are described here with a separate dated signature.

Greece publishes no separate national healthy-volunteer ICF; the ordinary Greek rules apply. No therapeutic benefit; dose escalation, sentinel dosing, stopping rules, confinement, restrictions; known human evidence separated from animal or laboratory findings; payment basis, amount, schedule and what happens after early withdrawal; reproductive precautions. Phase I adds GR-M-PHASE1-DECL, GR-M-ALS and GR-N-PHASE1 outside the ICF.
population_sets.basis: Variation of the main Greek patient information and consent form

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_children 6-9_<population>_EL_el
documents.when: enrolled children under 10 who can understand a child-facing sheet

population_sets.note: Minor = under 18. Both parents exercising parental responsibility (or the court-appointed guardian) consent jointly in writing; written assent from age 10; below 10 age-adapted information whenever the child can understand it and a capable child's refusal respected. Re-consent on the adult form at 18. Optional activities: the child's age-appropriate agreement and parental permission separately from main-trial consent.

Only adults under court-appointed judicial support (full or partial deprivation or assistance). Representative = the court-appointed judicial supporter. Participant's own written agreement when and to the extent able; capable refusal binding. Article 31 CTR conditions. The two forms may be integrated when that gives a clear process; separate forms are the default.

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_emergency representative_<population>_EL_el
documents.template_status: missing: no dedicated emergency-representative template supplied; drafted from the emergency template addressed to the representative, with its representative signature block as the consent page and every deviation visible (DECISIONS.md D3)

population_sets.note: All Article 35 conditions. Greek emergency representative (Article 35 only): spouse, civil partner, adult descendant, ascendant or sibling, whoever can consent fastest. The guide requires both a participant information and subsequent-consent form and an emergency-representative information and consent form. Full dates and times where timing affects compliance. A minor moves to the minors set as soon as possible; an adult under court-appointed support to the adults_without_capacity set.

Deaf or unable to speak: written exchange with at least one independent witness; unable to read or write: two independent witnesses; audio or video recording with at least one witness where the approved application covers it. Witnesses legally capable and unconnected with the trial. Not for language barriers (translations) or incapacity (representative).

Focused Greek pregnancy form (or a clearly separated section) when follow-up goes beyond the main ICF. Infant data after birth (pregnancy.infant_follow_up): separate dated consent page signed by both parents or guardians and the investigator.

The partner's own Greek information and consent; the enrolled participant cannot authorise access to her information. The signature page always includes contingency fields for a legally designated representative and two impartial witnesses (National Ethics Committee). Infant data: separate dated page signed by both parents or guardians and the investigator.

Separate focused Greek optional-use form for activities not necessary for the main trial (future research with coded data, long-term storage or future use of samples, optional genetic or genomic research, sharing for a new research purpose). Optional activities inside the protocol (for example optional PK or biomarker substudy) may instead be a clearly separate optional choice in the main form. A clear, separately signed choice per separable activity; refusal does not affect the main trial. Minors and adults under court-appointed support: the participant's agreement plus the parents' or judicial supporter's consent.

population_sets_note: population_sets list which templates a kind of population triggers; the actual populations are defined per study (playbook section 2a) and each population gets its own documents.
drafting_rules: Participant documents follow the Greek National Ethics Committee ICF guidance (11 October 2019) as recorded in the guides; keep the supplied template structure and model text and add every study-specific item. Record any deviation from the model text as a finding.
Information and consent form one unified, continuously paginated Greek document (Σελίδα Χ από Υ, total page count); every page shows document type, protocol code or acronym, version and date.
The wording must be accurate, complete and understandable without relying on the oral discussion to repair omissions; plain, non-promotional Greek; abbreviations and medical terms explained.
State that participants and their public or private insurers do not bear trial-specific costs for investigational or auxiliary products, examinations, procedures or treatment of trial-related injury.

Privacy information together in one section: controller and DPO contacts, purposes and legal bases, recipients, third-country transfers and safeguards, retention, rights, complaint to the Hellenic Data Protection Authority, automated decision-making if any; no promise of deletion that CTR safety, scientific-integrity or retention duties limit; consistent with R1.
Direct access to medical records by authorised sponsor representatives, EOF, the National Ethics Committee and other competent inspectors; public registration and lay summary of results.
The National Ethics Committee contact is for ethics questions and is not described as the complaints authority.

Consent: prior in-person interview by a qualified investigator or authorised team member, paper form, full dates for every signer in the same encounter, signed copy to the participant, original at the site. Blank, unsigned forms in CTIS with every signature and full-date field that could apply; representative and witness fields only where the protocol can use those pathways.

Main-trial consent separate from optional activities: each genuinely separable optional activity is described fully and recorded with its own dated signature of the person consenting and the investigator, not with a YES/NO box or initials (supplied templates); refusal does not affect the main trial.
Risks by likelihood and seriousness where the evidence supports it; blood volumes in ml/cc, not in comparisons such as spoonfuls.
Healthy volunteers: no therapeutic benefit; known human evidence distinguished from animal or laboratory findings; uncertainty not converted into reassurance.
Do not include groups the Greek implementing decision excludes from clinical trials (compulsory military service, custodial sentence, barred by court decision, living in institutions).
Insurance and injury-compensation wording matches the certificate, including the pregnancy clause; nothing promised beyond the policy.
Modifications: final Greek clean version and a tracked-change version against the previously approved form; define which enrolled participants are re-consented and when.

Participant templates (JSON): italic text, [square-bracket] notes and "..........." gaps are drafting instructions or gaps; follow them and remove them. Part II templates (DOCX): yellow [INSERT/IF/OTHERWISE/CHOOSE/NOTE: …] labels. Nothing of either may remain in a final document.
sources_note: All eleven Greece guides reviewed 23 September 2026 (read 27 November 2026); they record the Greek National Ethics Committee ICF guidance and Circular (11 October 2019), JMD G5a/59676 (Government Gazette B 4131/2016), the Greek Part II Q&A v1 (23 November 2022), the MedEthicsEU Member State overview v4.0 (26 June 2026), Government Gazette B 230/22.01.2026 and the National Ethics Committee clarification on financial benefits (22 July 2026). Anchors #1-#9 refer to the numbered items of the Part II checklist page.

naming.convention: content/playbook/naming.md (CTCG Best Practice Guide: Naming of Documents in CTIS, v3.0, 10 February 2026)
naming.greece_note: Use the CTCG pattern with _EL for country-level documents and _EL_el for participant-facing documents (DECISIONS.md D1: CTIS and the EU identify Greece as EL; the supplied template files keep GR). Translations carry the ISO code of their language instead of el. Personal names only for the principal investigator in M1/M2; Phase I ALS certificates are titled by site. The Greece checklist page uses descriptive section names (for example 'Suitability of the facilities', 'Proof of insurance cover or indemnification'); the CTCG titles are used.

document_kinds.form: Regulatory form the assistant answers question by question. Keep the template layout and questions unchanged.
document_kinds.participant_document: Participant- or representative-facing document written section by section from a participant template, for one population.
document_kinds.third_party_template: Template completed by someone else (investigator). The assistant fills only trial fields (title, EU trial number) and leaves every other field empty for that person.
document_kinds.third_party_document: Document issued by someone else (insurer, investigator, site, translator, sponsor finance). Recorded as a source when received; only checked.
document_kinds.ctis_data: Information entered as structured data in CTIS; checked against the plan.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Assent Form - Adolescents
participant_templates.name_el: Έντυπο Πληροφόρησης και Συναίνεσης μετά από Ενημέρωση – Έφηβοι 10–14 ετών
participant_templates.role: age-adapted information and written assent for minors 10-14
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving adolescent participants (aged 12 - 17 years).
participant_templates.authority_note: The template description says 'aged 12 - 17 years'; Greek law requires written assent from age 10, and the file name and content are for 10-14. The authority wins: catalogued as the 10-14 band.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Consent Form - Adolescents
participant_templates.name_el: Έντυπο Συναίνεσης μετά από Ενημέρωση – Έφηβοι 15–17 ετών
participant_templates.role: age-adapted information and written assent for minors 15-17 (keeps the adult form's structure and completeness)
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving adolescent participants (aged 12 - 17 years).
participant_templates.authority_note: The template description says 'aged 12 - 17 years'; file name and content are for 15-17, within the authority's 10-17 written-assent range. Catalogued as the 15-17 band.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Assent Form - Children
participant_templates.role: age-adapted information for children under 10 (no written assent required; optional record of the child's view)
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving children participants (aged 6 - 11 years).
participant_templates.authority_note: The template description says 'aged 6 - 11 years'; in Greece written assent starts at 10, so children 10-11 use the 10-14 template. File name and content are for 6-9. The authority wins.

participant_templates.name_en: Emergency Enrolment and Deferred Consent Form
participant_templates.name_el: Έντυπο Επείγουσας Ένταξης και Αναβαλλόμενης Συναίνεσης
participant_templates.role: information and subsequent consent after emergency enrolment, with optional representative and witness blocks
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves emergency enrolment before prior informed consent because neither the participant nor a legal representative can provide consent within the required treatment window.
participant_templates.authority_note: Also the interim basis for the separate emergency-representative form the Greece guide requires (DECISIONS.md D3).

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Consent Form - Healthy Adults
participant_templates.name_el: Έντυπο Συναίνεσης μετά από Ενημέρωση – Υγιείς ενήλικες
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving healthy adult participants (18 or older without a specific health condition). Can be used for non-treated participants when no other template applies.

participant_templates.name_en: Trial Information and Consent Form - Legal Representative
participant_templates.name_el: Έντυπο Συναίνεσης μετά από Ενημέρωση – Νομίμως Ορισμένος Εκπρόσωπος Ενήλικου Συμμετέχοντα
participant_templates.role: information and consent for the court-appointed judicial supporter of an adult without capacity
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves adult participants who cannot provide informed consent and participation must be authorised by a legally authorised representative.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Assent Form - Limited Capacity
participant_templates.name_el: Προσαρμοσμένο Έντυπο Ενημέρωσης και Συναίνεσης – Ενήλικος συμμετέχων με περιορισμένη ικανότητα
participant_templates.role: adapted information and the participant's own written agreement (adult under court-appointed support)
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves an adult lacking consent capacity who retains sufficient understanding to receive adapted information and express assent, willingness or objection. It accompanies the legal representative’s consent.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Consent Form - Adult Patients
participant_templates.name_el: Έντυπο Συναίνεσης μετά από Ενημέρωση – Ενήλικες ασθενείς
participant_templates.role: main information and consent (capable adult patients)
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving adult patients (18 or older & diagnosed with a specific health condition). Can be used for patients when no other template applies such as re-consent after reaching adulthood, regained capacity, prescreening, or optional substudies or extension arms.

participant_templates.name_en: Trial Information and Consent Form - Parents
participant_templates.name_el: Έντυπο Συναίνεσης μετά από Ενημέρωση – Νομίμως Ορισμένοι Εκπρόσωποι Ανήλικου Συμμετέχοντα
participant_templates.role: joint consent of both parents exercising parental responsibility, or a court-appointed guardian
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving minor participants (younger than 18 years).

participant_templates.name_el: Έντυπο Ενημέρωσης και Συναίνεσης για Παρακολούθηση Κύησης – Έγκυος συμμετέχουσα
participant_templates.role: pregnancy follow-up of a participant, with a separate two-parent infant-data page
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves collection of pregnancy outcome, maternal-health or infant-health information from a pregnant trial participant.

participant_templates.name_el: Έντυπο Ενημέρωσης και Συναίνεσης για Παρακολούθηση Κύησης – Έγκυος σύντροφος συμμετέχοντα
participant_templates.role: information and consent of a participant's pregnant partner, with representative and two-witness contingency fields and a separate two-parent infant-data page
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves collection of pregnancy outcome, maternal-health or infant-health information from the pregnant partner of a male trial participant.

participant_templates.name_en: Secondary and Future Use of Data or Biosamples
participant_templates.name_el: Έντυπο Ενημέρωσης και Συναίνεσης – Δευτερογενής / Μελλοντική Χρήση Δεδομένων ή Βιολογικών Δειγμάτων
participant_templates.role: optional secondary or future use of data or samples (separate focused form)
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves optional storage or secondary use of participant data, biological samples or genetic material beyond the mandatory purposes of the main clinical trial.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Consent Form - Impartial Witness
participant_templates.name_el: Έντυπο Συναίνεσης μετά από Ενημέρωση με Αμερόληπτο Μάρτυρα/Μάρτυρες
participant_templates.role: consent with one or two independent witnesses or an approved audio/video record
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves an adult participant who has capacity to consent but cannot read, write or sign the standard consent form. The participant decides personally, while an impartial witness confirms and documents the consent process.
participant_templates.authority_note: The Greek route also covers a deaf participant or one unable to speak (at least one witness, written exchange); unable to read or write needs two witnesses (JMD G5a/59676, Article 9). The template's model text covers all three routes.

population_rules.authority: Greek National Ethics Committee for Clinical Studies (Informed Consent Form guidance and Circular, 11 October 2019; clarification on financial benefits, 22 July 2026); Greek Joint Ministerial Decision G5a/59676, Government Gazette B 4131/22.12.2016 (Articles 2, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 15); Greek Part II Q&A, version 1, 23 November 2022; Regulation (EU) No 536/2014, Articles 28 to 35

age_bands.assent: no automatic written assent below 10; child-facing information whenever the child can understand it; the child's agreement is sought and a capable refusal respected
written, signed and dated assent from age 10

minors.reconsent_at_18: GR-PT-main or GR-PT-healthy: own adult consent for continued participation when the participant turns 18; document the transition promptly
minors.under_6: No age-band template. Inform the child according to age and maturity whenever the child can understand, seek the child's agreement and respect a capable child's clear refusal; a child-facing sheet only when the protocol population can understand one.
minors.assent_from_10: Mandatory written assent from age 10 (JMD G5a/59676, Article 10); the minor is informed by the principal investigator, an investigator or an authorised team member trained or experienced with children. The minor's signature never replaces the parents' consent.
minors.parents: Both parents exercising parental responsibility consent jointly (signature and full date for each), or the court-appointed guardian. Single-parent exceptions: the other's parental responsibility ended (death, declaration of absence, legal removal), or the other is demonstrably unable for factual reasons (formal declaration attached) or lacks legal capacity. Day-to-day custody alone is not enough; disagreement goes to the court.
minors.band_split: The guide asks for separate versions when one form cannot serve the whole 10-17 range. The parents template cites the National Ethics Committee's split into 2 or 3 bands by maturity with indicative ranges 10-12, 13-15 and 16-18; the supplied templates give two bands (10-14, 15-17) (DECISIONS.md D5).
conflicts: Template descriptions say 'aged 12 - 17 years' (10-14 and 15-17 templates) and 'aged 6 - 11 years' (6-9 template); the Greek written-assent threshold of 10 wins. File names and content already follow it.

adults_without_capacity.note: Only adults under court-ordered judicial support covering the case; representative = the court-appointed judicial supporter exercising the care function. The participant's own written agreement when and to the extent able (JMD G5a/59676); capable refusal binding; representative expresses the presumed will. Regained capacity: GR-PT-main. Greek exclusions: compulsory military service, custodial sentence, barred by court decision, living in institutions.

emergency.note: Participant information and subsequent consent (GR-PT-emergency) and a separate emergency-representative information and consent form (no dedicated template; interim basis GR-PT-emergency, DECISIONS.md D3). Article 35 representative list: spouse, civil partner, adult descendant, ascendant or sibling, whoever can consent fastest; Article 35 only. Minor participants move to GR-PT-parents and the age-band forms; adults under court-appointed support to GR-PT-legal-rep.

impartial_witness.note: One witness for a deaf participant or one unable to speak (written exchange); two witnesses for a participant unable to read or write; audio or video record with at least one witness where approved. For minors the parents' consent and the child's assent still apply.

pregnancy.participant: GR-PT-pregnancy when follow-up goes beyond the main trial information
pregnancy.partner: GR-PT-pregnant-partner whenever identifiable information is collected from the partner or her records
pregnancy.infant: Both pregnancy templates carry a separate dated infant-data page signed by both parents or guardians and the investigator (pregnancy.infant_follow_up).

separate_document_rules: Optional activities not necessary for the main trial (future research with coded data, long-term storage or future use of samples, optional genetic research, sharing for a new research purpose) need a separate focused Greek form (GR-PT-secondary) or, for optional activities within the protocol, a clearly separate optional choice in the main form; refusal must not affect the main trial.
Infant or newborn data need a separate consent from both parents or guardians of the child (a separate dated signature page at the end of the pregnancy form is allowed).
A pregnant partner receives her own document; the enrolled participant cannot authorise access to her information.
Representative and participant forms for adults under court-appointed support may be integrated when that is clearer; separate forms are the default.
Emergency enrolment needs a participant subsequent-consent form and a separate emergency-representative form.

answer_languages_note: en: answer language of the Part II forms (K1, N1, P1, R1, S1) and the trial fields of M1/M2, as the Greece guide recommends. el: language of every participant-facing document (K2, L1, L2). Per-document languages are in documents[].language and language_rules.by_language. Greek form answers only if the user decides so (DECISIONS.md D2).
